task.title: Install Manually from a File or Update Site
task.shortdesc: Install the Git Client from the update site, or from a downloaded package when the site cannot be reached.

step.cmd: Go to Help Install new add-ons .
In the Show add-ons from field, enter https://www.oxygenxml.com/InstData/Addons/default/updateSite.xml.

info.note: If you have trouble reaching the update site, download the add-on package, unzip it, and use Browse for local files to select the addon.xml file instead.

step.cmd: Select the Git Client add-on, then select Next.
Read the license agreement and accept it.
